data.text: KAD-75 measured 2026-10-12: 10 headless Claude Code sessions (opus-5-5, kadence 0.9.1 frozen, fresh repo, KADENCE_INTERACTIVE=0 init, nothing else added), each with a real choice between approaches. 9 of 10 recorded a decision without being asked, all source: agent, all with a substantive why. 0 of 9 used --rejected; 7 named the losing option inside the why prose instead. The one miss (a stock race) was treated as a bug fix and recorded as a note. 10/10 opened with kadence search; the prompt hook fired in 10/10 and printed nothing in all 10 (fresh journal, nothing to match). 3 sessions created and claimed their own task and left it in in_review; one committed to git on its own. Criterion 4 does not trigger: 9 of 10 is above half.
